''This page is about the currently obtainable variation. For the separate variation coming later, see [[Hybrid]].''




'''Hybrids''' are half vampire, half werewolf — both ability sets in one character, with no sun-burning.




== How to Become One ==
Original Hybrid isn't bought directly. According to the game's owner on Discord, you need:
* To be level 5,000.
* A player at level 3,000 or higher to transform you.
* The Original Vampire (ANTICIPATED) gamepass.
The chance is 0.5% - 0.1% the verified source keeps changing ⚠️ — it depends on luck. The owner also said it doesn't matter whether you are a vampire or a werewolf. How it happens depends on your side: if you are a vampire, the assisting werewolf scratches you; if you are a werewolf, you drink blood while a vampire assists.




== Abilities ==
Both vampire and werewolf ability sets in one character. In-game keybinds:
* '''X''' — Heart Rip
* '''B''' — Sleep
* '''F''' — Track
* '''V''' — Break Neck
* '''E''' — Drink Blood
* '''C''' — Hypnotize
* '''R''' — Infect
* '''LeftControl''' — Barrage
* '''L1+Up''' — Ground Slam
* '''H''' — Head Rip
* '''T''' — Pierce Organs
* '''Q''' — Bat Swarm
* '''L1+Right''' — Wolf Form
No sun-burning, unlike pure vampires. A video report describes the split as vampire in normal form and werewolf in beast form.

== Strengths and Weaknesses ==
* '''Strengths:''' Two full kits, no sunlight weakness, Original Hybrid potential
* '''Weaknesses:''' Requires level 5,000, a level 3,000+ transforming player, and the Original Vampire gamepass at a 0.5% chance (also stated as 0.1%); high-priority target.
